_comment: Cursor permissions.json: deploy to ~/.cursor/permissions.json. Used by Allowlist mode (terminalAllowlist/mcpAllowlist) and Auto-review mode (autoRun instructions). Team dashboard policies take highest precedence.

allow_instructions: Safe local lint, typecheck, and unit-test commands may run without asking when they do not install packages or change infrastructure.
block_instructions: Every AWS CLI command should go through approval first.
Every command that modifies Kubernetes resources should go through approval first.
Every curl or wget piped to a shell should go through approval first.
Every command that reads .env, credential, token, PEM, or SSH key files should go through approval first.
Every sudo command should go through approval first.
Every MCP tool that can write data or call external APIs should go through approval first.
